name: Poliisit 24/7
overview: The new series Poliisit 24/7 takes viewers on a journey through the everyday lives of police patrols in four locations: Kuopio, Oulu, Hyvinkää and Tampere. The series, which follows the patrols' everyday shifts, offers an opportunity to see up close what police work entails and what kinds of situations can arise when patrols are out and about protecting citizens' lives around the clock: the sad cases of drowning during the summer heatwave, problems caused by alpha PVP, scooter accidents and other disturbances are the everyday lives of the police. In the midst of it all, situations are resolved in a cafe together with a patrol buddy - often through humor.
